description: Port of SQLFluff 4.4.0's ST02 (structure.simple_case): report searched CASE expressions with one WHEN that reduce to boolean COALESCE or a NULL-filling expression; simple CASE, multiple WHENs, compound NULL predicates, and DISTINCT FROM remain untouched. Anchor the WHEN condition.

violation.message: Unnecessary CASE statement. Use COALESCE function instead.
